blind_spots.blind_spot: No sustainment or training model for a 'warfighter recovery system'
blind_spots.operator_reality: A material-enabled recovery/performance-restoration product still needs someone at the unit level trained to use, restock, and maintain it; naming the product category without addressing who trains the corpsman or resupplies the consumable is exactly where excellent chemistry dies at the fielding gate.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The site is written for program-office and prime-contractor evaluators assessing technical readiness, not for the operator-facing logistics question, which likely hasn't been engineered yet at prototype stage.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Material-enabled systems supporting measurable warfighter recovery, performance restoration, and operational readiness outcomes.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The funded-months-remaining clock is public and running out in real time
blind_spots.operator_reality: A 3-4 person company juggling four concurrent funded programs (USMC x2, NAVSEA, ONR) with one contract showing '2 months remain' is the literal valley-of-death math Barry's EDP describes — if months-to-transition exceeds what's left on this contract, the program (and likely a meaningful share of the company) is at risk.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: This isn't a blind spot in their language so much as a fact publicly visible on USAspending that their own marketing site (understandably) doesn't surface.

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Delivery architectures for controlled material effects at distance' never addresses SWaP-C or export control
blind_spots.operator_reality: A delivery system meant to be carried/deployed by an operator has hard size/weight/power/cost constraints, and 'formulation' plus 'dispensing hardware' for military effect is a plausible ITAR-controlled technical-data category — neither SWaP-C nor export-control language appears anywhere despite four active USMC/NAVSEA/ONR programs.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Public site language is intentionally high-level ('detailed scope is shared under NDA'), so SWaP-C and ITAR specifics may exist internally but aren't part of the public technical narrative that a partner or prime evaluator would see first.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Delivery architectures for controlled material effects at distance — integrating formulation, flow behavior, dispensing hardware, target interaction, and measured performance.

opener_hook: Your NAVSEA contract N6833525C0287 shows 2 months remaining on USAspending — worth comparing notes on what it takes to get from prototype demonstration to transition before that clock runs out.
what_they_do: A materials-science and hardware R&D company building composite tooling, controlled material-effect delivery systems, and warfighter recovery systems under active USMC, NAVSEA, and ONR SBIR/STTR-funded programs.
